headSubject: fix(xref): REG-311 -- index the fields inside a v2 where/having (OR, in, contains, is null, reference paths)
summary: Fixed REG-309 (per-concept crud.kernelControlled was ignored by generation: a concept-level true under an app-level false generated no authz and passed REG-44), REG-310 (probe fl-monitor-reports-compensated-execution raced on items[0]; now selects by executionId) and REG-311 (ReferenceIndex now indexes fields inside v2 where/having: OR, in, contains, is null, reference paths, under query.where.v2/query.having.v2). All pushed to main (88cd72ff, cca48555). Candidate #3 (properties[] with internal.tables off) was investigated and NOT done: a generation-time error would break WmsOffice, dsl-conformance-max and pigmentampas.
nextStep: Pick one: (a) safe version of properties[] without internal.tables: in NPDevKernel/kernel/.../properties/DefaultPropertyResolver.set() throw a dedicated, clearly worded exception when workspace::PropertyValue is not in the live model (needs an HTTP mapping like PropertyNotSettableAtScopeException), with a unit test beside PropertyResolverUnknownConceptTest; or (b) in-process acceptance runner support for when.flow (NPDevRuntimeHost/runtimehost-core/.../acceptance/InProcessAcceptanceRunner.java:51,76,111, not in the ledger yet). Optional follow-up from REG-311: make npdev_rename_cascade.py rewrite query.where.v2 per hop instead of whole-string, with a cascade test. OWN-2 and AIP-4 4.5 still need the owner (AIP-4: the Manager exe at Build/manager-target/release is stale, built 2026-09-09; Rust + MSVC not installed).
verified: REG-309/310: new ServiceBasePerConceptKernelControlTest 3/3 (2 of 3 red without the fix), neighbouring generator tests green, run-generator-gate.ps1 green, InMemory behaviour probes 135/135 (6 skipped, need h2local/restart variants). REG-311: dsl module 1290 tests, 0 failures; ReferenceIndexTest and ReferenceIntegrityValidationTest red-checked both ways; run-ai-knowledge-gate.ps1 green (52 checks). NOT run: run-runtimehost-gate, run-kernel-quality-gate, weeklyPaperwork, h2local probe variant; a bare run-all-gates was not run after the final commit.
